snippet.title: Team 17's Advent Calendar: Day 8 (Free DLC!)
snippet.description:
Today's Advent surprise is brand new FREE DLC for The Escapists! 

Santa's Sweatshop is available to download today on PC and PS4, and  Xbox One.

Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/412990/#app_reviews_hash
PS4 (Europe): https://store.playstation.com/#!/en-gb/games/addons/santa%27s-sweatshop/cid=EP4064-CUSA01857_00-THEESCAPISTS0004?smcid=pdc:gb-en:pdc-buy-playstation-store:herobanner-shop-now:null:null
